---
name: Reproducibility report
about: Report a run mismatch with exact provenance
---

## Configuration and version
Attach the config, run manifest, asset/source hashes and command.

## Runtime
Python, PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy, operating system and CPU/GPU settings.

## Observed versus expected result
Distinguish imported evidence, historical numerical replay and fresh runs.

## Logs
Attach the smallest relevant logs and raw rows. Do not include credentials,
private filesystem content, or a full virtual environment.
